AM4-01.note: x(x+6)=16 gives x=2 or x=-8; -8 is excluded by the domain of log2(x). (A) is exactly that rejected branch, so the exclusion is real, not cosmetic.

AM4-02.note: 200(1/2)^(t/12)<25 needs t>36; at t=36 the mass is exactly 25 g, which is not less than 25. (C) is the boundary trap but the stem says 'less than', so it is not defensible.

AM4-03.note: 1.44^(1/2)=1.2. (B) 1.22 is a near-miss with no clean mis-step behind it; (D) 0.72 is 1.44/2.

AM4-05.note: u=2^x gives u=4 or u=-1; u=-1 impossible, so 2^x=4, x=2. (C) is the u-value, (D) is 4^x, (A) the rejected root.

AM4-07.note: a=5, b^2=9. The stem's phrase 'f is an exponential function' carries b>0 by definition, so b=3 and f(3)=135; without that phrase b=-3 would make (A) -135 equally valid. The item survives ONLY on that one word - if the wording is ever edited, this becomes a two-answer item. Worth pinning.

AM4-08.note: p(2)=3(2)+1=7; (A) -5 is p(-2), a real and distinct mis-step.

AM4-09.note: a+b=3 and -a+b=-7 give a=5, b=-2. (B) is b, (C) is a+b, (A) is -a+b.

AM4-10.note: r=p(-3)=-54+27+33+5=11. (D) 53 is p(3), (A) -11 is the linear coefficient.

AM4-11.note: c+d=5 and -2c+d=-1 give c=2, d=3; p(-3)=-27-6+3=-30. (B) -27 is the cube term alone.

AM4-12.note: Sum of all three zeros is -5/2; subtracting the known zero 2 gives -9/2. (C) is the full sum, (D) the given zero.

AM4-13.note: Quotient is x^2-x-2; at x=-3 that is 10. (A) -3 is the x-coordinate of the hole, a common misread of 'y-coordinate'.

AM4-14.note: x=0 and x=5; x=0 is extraneous (2 != -2). b=y=3. (A) -2 is the y-value at the extraneous root, (B) the extraneous x, (D) is a.

AM4-15.note: Discriminant 4-4(7-k)>0 gives k>6, so least integer is 7. k=6 is tangency (one point), correctly excluded by 'exactly two points'.

AM4-16.note: x=2,5; y=-4 and 5; sum 1. Equivalently 3(x1+x2)-20=1. (C) 7 is the sum of the x-coordinates.

AM4-17.note: -16t^2+48t+4>36 reduces to (t-1)(t-2)<0, so 1<t<2: a duration of 1 second. (C) 2 is the upper root read as an answer, (B) 1.5 the vertex time.

AM4-19.note: x+y=10 with x-y=4 gives x=7, y=3. (A) is y, (C) is x+y.

AM4-20.note: 2x=-2 and 2x=6 give x=-1 and 3; sum 2. (C) 4 is the untransformed sum, (D) 8 the doubled one.

AM4-21.note: Right 3, up 4: (4,-1). The three wrong options are the three sign-error combinations.

AM4-24.note: g is decreasing in f, so the max of g comes from the min of f: -2(-1)+5=7. (D) 13 uses f=4 with the sign dropped, (A) -3 is the least value of g.
